title: Facet force at L2-L3, L4-L5 - Lorenz M, Patwardhan A, Vanderby R 1983 (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet force left/right (pressure-sensitive film); the review also prints the % of axial compression in parentheses (kept in note)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Lorenz M, Patwardhan A, Vanderby R 1983); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Lorenz M, Patwardhan A, Vanderby R 1983, as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: 140 kg (~1373 N) axial compression, alone or with 6-8 deg extension; pressure film. Percent load share values: L2-L3 9% / 17%, L4-L5 8% / 13% (compression / with extension).
how_to_simulate: Apply 140 kg (1373 N) compression, with or without 6-8 deg extension
Report left and right facet force
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (the user's own review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Lorenz M, Patwardhan A, Vanderby R 1983.

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
